## Problem and change

Explain why this change is needed and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List commands and results, plus host/client scenarios tested. Explicitly mention
checks you could not run and whether game reference assemblies were available.

## Compatibility and security

Describe protocol/save/API compatibility, untrusted input handling, new dependencies,
and any permission changes. Report vulnerabilities privately using SECURITY.md.

- [ ] The change is focused and targets `develop`.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated, or omissions are explained.
- [ ] No secrets, private logs, or game reference assemblies are included.
- [ ] Incompatible protocol changes update `versions.json` and generated constants, if applicable.
